new residual experiment implementation or execution

families.hypothesis: Scoped identity and lineage continuity can survive representation migration.
families.why_not_tested_by_bpv1: BPV1-001 did not perform or adjudicate a source-to-target representation migration preserving or breaking identity and continuation relations.
target_semantic_obligations: A5 typed/scoped identity and MIGRATED_FROM/CONTINUATION_OF semantics
A8-P10 explicit capability and loss declaration
families.testable_question: Can a materially different target representation preserve the declared semantic identity and lineage relations while substrate-local identity changes, without using source-format physical identity as the semantic decision rule?
families.candidate_realization_class: A source representation and a materially different target representation with different local identifiers/layout/history form; migration may carry declared provenance or bounded companion evidence, but the oracle must not infer semantic continuity from equal bytes, copied IDs, hashes, source row keys, or successful deserialization.
families.equivalence_predicate: For every preregistered case, materially required semantic identity/lineage relations agree with the frozen external semantic oracle after migration, while differences in substrate-local identity, encoding, layout, or byte representation do not count as semantic failure by themselves.
allowed_losses: declared non-material metadata outside the test scope
failure_condition: semantic continuity is inferred solely from copied/equal source identifiers, hashes, bytes, or source-format physical identity
material Context/Provenance/Authority or lineage is silently dropped
a target representation cannot distinguish SAME, DISTINCT, CONTINUATION_OF, MIGRATED_FROM, or UNRESOLVED where the scope requires the distinction
loss is hidden while a stronger equivalence claim is emitted
families.hard_refutation: A reproducible migration case preserves all declared meaning-level content required by scope yet required identity/continuation cannot be justified without making source-format physical identity itself a universal semantic requirement.
families.grounding_mode: Externally specified semantic cases plus raw source/target artifacts and migration facts; semantic qualification occurs outside the migration subject.
threat_trust_model: migration implementation may copy source IDs or leak oracle labels
matching visible content may hide provenance or authority loss
same-team assumptions may couple source and target semantics
oracle must not inspect private target internals
families.oracle_authority: Frozen implementation-neutral migration oracle operating on externally visible identity/provenance/lineage observations and declared loss only.
reproduction_requirements: immutable source case set and semantic relation expectations
families.expected_evidence: Per-case migration evidence package showing physical/representation difference, raw semantic observations, externally derived relation verdicts, loss declarations, and one allowed A10 outcome.

families.hypothesis: Forgetting and disposal can be represented without claiming impossible knowledge of physical substrate state.
families.why_not_tested_by_bpv1: Physical and cryptographic erasure were explicitly outside BPV1-001 applicability; bounded loss/compaction evidence is not physical-residue or key-destruction evidence.
target_semantic_obligations: A5 separation of restriction, logical erasure, physical deletion, cryptographic erasure, and forgetting/loss
families.testable_question: Can the system keep logical disposal, semantic forgetting/loss, cryptographic erasure, physical erasure, and unknown physical residue distinct, while making no claim stronger than independently observable evidence and without retaining prohibited content or secrets merely to prove absence?
families.candidate_realization_class: Three separately adjudicated evidence lanes: (L) logical/semantic forgetting on a substrate with opaque physical residue; (C) encrypted storage with independently controlled key lifecycle and externally validated cryptographic-erasure evidence; (P) a media/substrate case with an independently inspectable sanitization/physical-erasure validation path. Lane L must permit physical/crypto status to remain INDETERMINATE.

evidence_lanes.qualifying_claim: bounded cryptographic erasure only when key sanitization and recoverability assumptions are independently evidenced
bounded physical/media sanitization only when residue/recoverability is independently inspectable under a declared effort/threat boundary

observables: key custody and sanitization evidence where cryptographic erasure is claimed
media sanitization/physical residue validation evidence where physical erasure is claimed
unknown/indeterminate status where observability is absent
families.equivalence_predicate: The emitted disposal/erasure claim class must equal or be weaker than the independently established evidence class; logical forgetting is conformant when semantic recoverability is removed for scope while physical/cryptographic state remains explicitly INDETERMINATE unless separately evidenced.
allowed_losses: secrets whose destruction is the object of a cryptographic-erasure claim
physical microstate unavailable to the declared observation boundary
implementation-specific deletion workflow details outside scope
failure_condition: logical inaccessibility is promoted to physical or cryptographic erasure
subject self-report is the only basis for an erasure PASS
forgotten/lost is collapsed into never-existed or false
the only way to prove forgetting requires retaining prohibited recoverable content or secret material
opaque physical residue is reported as erased instead of INDETERMINATE
families.hard_refutation: Within a declared scope, the architecture cannot preserve the semantic distinction among logical forgetting, cryptographic erasure, physical erasure, and unknown residue without either retaining the prohibited material or issuing an unjustifiably strong erasure claim.
families.grounding_mode: External recoverability probes, custody records, and sanitization validation appropriate to each lane; no subject-authored PASS booleans are authoritative.
threat_trust_model: hidden replicas/backups or stale physical residue
destroyed-key self-report without independent custody evidence
forbidden proof material retained by the evaluator
vendor or subject attestation treated as ground truth
recovery effort boundary left undefined
families.oracle_authority: Lane-specific external qualifier: semantic recoverability oracle for L, independent key/custody and recoverability evidence for C, independent sanitization/physical observability for P. Absence of qualifying evidence yields INDETERMINATE, not PASS.
reproduction_requirements: pre-disposition inventory without unnecessary secret disclosure
families.expected_evidence: Separate lane evidence packages; H06 adjudication must distinguish successful epistemic boundary discipline from any stronger physical/cryptographic capability claim.

families.hypothesis: A non-address-based substrate could preserve semantic identity and history through relational or dynamical continuity rather than stable byte addresses.
families.why_not_tested_by_bpv1: BPV1-001 used conventional digital computation and did not test analog or neuromorphic non-address-based continuity.
families.testable_question: Can a physical non-address-based dynamical realization preserve a scoped identity/lineage/accountability contract when exact microstate, stable row/byte address, and exact deterministic replay are unavailable?
families.candidate_realization_class: A physical analog, neuromorphic, reservoir/attractor, memristive, or other dynamical carrier in which semantic continuity is not identified with stable byte/row/neuron addresses. A companion mechanism is allowed only when declared as part of a hybrid profile and must not contain the entire authoritative semantic state such that the dynamical substrate becomes decorative.

qualification_tiers.HYBRID_PROFILE: ELIGIBLE_ONLY_FOR_DECLARED_HYBRID_SCOPE; COMPANION CANNOT HIDE ALL SEMANTIC STATE

observables: externally discriminable state/attractor or relational continuity classes
lineage and transformation relation across perturbation/change
Context/Authority/provenance observables or explicitly bounded companion records
recovery or continuation after benign physical drift
absence of stable physical-address identity as semantic oracle
families.equivalence_predicate: The frozen external oracle can recover the required semantic identity, lineage, uncertainty, authority, and accountability distinctions from declared external observations across admissible physical drift/perturbation, without relying on persistent byte/row/neuron addresses or a hidden full digital shadow.
allowed_losses: exact timing and weight values outside declared semantic scope
failure_condition: semantic identity is actually anchored to stable physical addresses or device IDs
a conventional companion stores the full authoritative semantic history and the dynamical substrate contributes no required semantic preservation
benign substrate drift destroys required lineage/accountability without declared loss
uncertainty, Context, Authority, or provenance can only be reconstructed by reading private implementation state
simulation is promoted as physical substrate evidence
families.hard_refutation: A qualifying physical non-address-based realization cannot preserve required semantic identity/lineage/accountability within the declared scope even when exact microstate and physical-address identity are explicitly non-required and a bounded non-authoritative companion is allowed.
families.grounding_mode: Raw physical measurements and externally supplied semantic challenge cases; implementation-neutral qualifier derives semantic observations without private-state access.
threat_trust_model: decorative neuromorphic/analog substrate backed by a full digital shadow
hidden persistent address labels
calibration drift or perturbation cherry-picking
oracle coupled to training/internal state
simulation mistaken for hardware-family evidence
families.oracle_authority: Frozen external semantic oracle over declared physical/hybrid observations, with an anti-shadow audit establishing where authoritative meaning actually resides.
families.expected_evidence: A physical/hybrid evidence package that makes the actual semantic carrier boundary inspectable and can falsify address-free continuity rather than merely demonstrate a neuromorphic computation task.

families.hypothesis: Probabilistic substrates can be assessed using bounded statistical conformance without redefining uncertainty as failure.
families.why_not_tested_by_bpv1: BPV1-001 used no probabilistic substrate and preregistered no repeated-trial statistical conformance protocol.
families.testable_question: Can a materially probabilistic realization be tested with preregistered repeated-trial statistics so that required semantic invariants remain falsifiable, distributional variation is bounded, and real semantic divergence cannot be excused post hoc as noise?
families.candidate_realization_class: A realization whose computation materially produces distributions rather than one deterministic byte-exact trajectory. Software stochastic simulation may qualify only the statistical protocol; H09 substrate support requires a materially probabilistic computation/substrate claim with independently captured repeated trials.
families.equivalence_predicate: Preregistration separates zero-tolerance semantic invariants from explicitly statistical obligations. Zero-tolerance claims admit no forbidden semantic outcome in their declared scope; statistical obligations must remain within preregistered equivalence/error bounds with sufficient power. Insufficient power or ambiguous measurement yields INDETERMINATE, not PASS.
allowed_losses: declared bounded stochastic variation outside hard semantic invariants
failure_condition: thresholds/equivalence margins/trial counts are chosen after observing adjudication data
semantic divergence is always excused as random noise
insufficient statistical power is reported as support
forbidden Unknown-to-False, plurality collapse, authority drift, or silent-loss outcomes occur under a scope claiming they cannot occur
selected/retried runs hide adverse trials
families.hard_refutation: Under a preregistered adequately powered protocol, required semantic distinctions cannot be separated from stochastic divergence strongly enough to keep the preservation claim falsifiable, or a hard semantic invariant is reproducibly violated within its claimed scope.
families.grounding_mode: Independently captured raw trial series; blinded/frozen statistical qualifier; semantic labels derived externally rather than supplied by the subject.
threat_trust_model: p-hacking or post-hoc equivalence margins
optional stopping
seed/random-source leakage
non-independent trials and environmental drift
discarded adverse samples
model uncertainty conflated with architecture uncertainty
families.oracle_authority: Two-layer frozen oracle: deterministic semantic rule checker for hard invariants plus preregistered statistical evaluator for distributional obligations.
reproduction_requirements: statistical analysis plan with alpha/power/equivalence margin where applicable
fixed trial count or preregistered stopping rule
families.expected_evidence: Complete repeated-trial dataset plus immutable statistical and semantic adjudication outputs that can produce SUPPORT, WEAKENED, REFUTED, INDETERMINATE, or NOT_TESTED without post-hoc rescue.

families.hypothesis: Storage and computation mechanisms can vary independently within declared semantic constraints.
families.why_not_tested_by_bpv1: BPV1-001 changed language, history model, and representation together, so storage and computation axes were not independently isolated.
families.testable_question: When storage model and computation model are varied orthogonally rather than together, can each axis change while the other is held materially fixed without changing a semantic law, identity relation, authority rule, or declared meaning-level outcome?
families.candidate_realization_class: A minimum 2x2 mechanism matrix: storage S1/S2 crossed with computation C1/C2. C1/C2 must differ in computation mechanism rather than merely programming language; S1/S2 must differ in storage model rather than schema/dialect only. The semantic challenge specification and oracle remain external to all four cells.
observables: storage-axis deltas while computation is held fixed
computation-axis deltas while storage is held fixed
families.equivalence_predicate: For preregistered obligations, S1↔S2 changes at fixed computation and C1↔C2 changes at fixed storage preserve the same meaning-level outcomes or explicitly declared allowed losses. A programming-language change alone does not qualify as a computation-model change.
allowed_losses: local scheduling/write-order differences not promoted to semantic order
failure_condition: one axis cannot be held fixed while the other changes
the shared interface smuggles one storage/computation mechanism into all cells
changing storage changes identity/authority/semantic law without declared applicability reason
changing computation changes required semantic meaning without declared applicability reason
same final value hides material provenance/uncertainty/authority divergence
families.hard_refutation: Within a scope claiming independent substitutability, an isolated storage or computation mechanism change necessarily alters a required semantic law, identity relation, authority rule, or accountability property rather than merely changing implementation mechanics or declared loss.
families.grounding_mode: Externally generated challenge cases and an implementation-neutral oracle shared across a preregistered orthogonal mechanism matrix.
threat_trust_model: fake independence via thin wrappers around one shared core
language difference mislabeled as computation-model difference
storage adapter carrying semantic logic
oracle coupled to one cell's internal representation
uncontrolled simultaneous axis changes
families.oracle_authority: Frozen cross-cell semantic comparator over external observations, provenance/authority/loss vectors, and explicit axis qualification evidence.
reproduction_requirements: formal axis qualification for S1/S2 and C1/C2
families.expected_evidence: A four-cell mechanism-isolation evidence matrix that can distinguish true axis independence from coupled implementation variation.

families.hypothesis: Laboratory mechanisms can remain reproducible without becoming Architecture Canon.
families.why_not_tested_by_bpv1: BPV1-001 did not preregister H11 as a falsification target. Existing repository governance evidence is informative but was not an H11 experiment.
target_semantic_obligations: A9 distinction between architecture-preserving evidence, profile-specific realization, laboratory-only constraint, and architecture authority
A8 separation of semantic obligation from realization mechanism
historical evidence reproducibility without retroactive Canon promotion
families.testable_question: Can exact reproduction of accepted laboratory evidence depend on profile-specific Python/SQL/JSON/hash/Event/reducer details while the Architecture specification and conformance oracle remain meaning-level and do not mandate those mechanisms universally?
families.candidate_realization_class: A dual-layer reproduction challenge: an immutable laboratory reproduction manifest may require exact profile bytes/tools/versions, while a separate architecture-obligation dependency graph and conformance specification must contain only meaning-level requirements. An independent reviewer/reproducer attempts both tasks without treating the lab manifest as Canon.
observables: successful or failed exact laboratory reproduction against its own profile manifest
dependency graph from architecture obligations to concrete mechanisms
architecture conformance checks that remain mechanism-neutral
historical evidence identity preserved without architecture rewrite
families.equivalence_predicate: Historical lab evidence may require exact profile-specific reproduction inputs, but no such input becomes a universal Architecture obligation unless independently justified at meaning level. Architecture reproducibility means the semantic obligation and falsifier remain testable without mandating current profile machinery.
allowed_losses: none for the exact historical laboratory artifact being reproduced
mechanism differences are allowed for separate architecture-level conformance exercises
profile-specific metadata may remain outside Architecture Canon
failure_condition: architecture documents must mandate Python, SQL, JSON, SHA-256, Event, reducer, exact replay, UUID, current clocks, or equivalent profile mechanism solely to reproduce laboratory evidence
architecture validators depend on profile bytes rather than meaning-level obligations
lab-only constraints are silently promoted to substrate-neutral requirements
historical evidence reproducibility requires rewriting architecture history
families.hard_refutation: A necessary accepted architecture obligation cannot remain reproducible/testable unless a profile-specific laboratory mechanism is elevated into universal Architecture solely because historical evidence reproduction depends on that mechanism.
families.grounding_mode: Repository dependency audit plus independently performed reproduction/review; architecture authors do not self-certify absence of mechanism leakage.
threat_trust_model: circular documentation where architecture cites the lab and the lab is then treated as architecture authority
hidden validators that enforce current bytes/mechanisms
same-author review bias
historical reproducibility confused with universal conformance
families.oracle_authority: Independent architecture-boundary reviewer using a frozen dependency/leakage rubric plus exact lab reproduction evidence under the laboratory's own versioned manifest.
reproduction_requirements: historical lab checkpoint and evidence identity
families.expected_evidence: A paired reproduction-and-boundary-audit package showing whether laboratory exactness can coexist with mechanism-neutral Architecture, with H11 outcome kept separate from substrate portability claims.

recommended_order.reason: Lowest execution burden and protects all later families from profile-to-Canon leakage.
Directly tests representation migration using conventional-digital resources without claiming new hardware support.
Requires careful 2x2 orthogonal mechanism design and clarifies what computation-model independence actually means before hardware claims.
Semantic/epistemic lane can be designed early; cryptographic/physical lanes require stronger custody and observation boundaries.
Statistical protocol should be qualified before any costly probabilistic-substrate adjudication.
Strongest specialized hardware requirement; should be attempted only after anti-shadow and external-oracle rules are mature.
